User story: As a new user I see the prism hero and can begin
Expected behavior (from code): Fresh install (UserConfig.onboardedAt nil) gates AppRootView to OnboardingFlow; WelcomeStep renders PrismArtifact + displaySm wordmark + cta-begin

User story: I must write an intention before continuing
Expected behavior (from code): IntentionStep CONTINUE disabled until trimmed non-empty; hard cap 80 chars; counter appears past 60; writes UserConfig.intentionText

User story: I pick 1–7 essential apps
Expected behavior (from code): EssentialsStep rows toggle bone/fog; cap at homeCap 7 (others 0.35 + inert); ≥1 required; EssentialApp rows inserted in tap order

User story: I grant Screen Time and move on
Expected behavior (from code): PermissionStep cta-allow → requestAuthorization; REQUESTING… pulse in-flight; approved auto-advances after beat; PillTag SIMULATOR MOCK when isMock

User story: Denied Screen Time still lets me in
Expected behavior (from code): MINUS_AUTH=denied → denied copy + TRY AGAIN + cta-skip-permission advances without auth
Notes: Real denial is a device story

User story: I choose what gets blocked
Expected behavior (from code): BlockedStep: device = familyActivityPicker + summary via selectionSummary; sim = mock list → MockScreenTimeService.encodeSelection; writes BlockList.selectionData

User story: I can skip blocking for now
Expected behavior (from code): cta-skip-blocked leaves selectionData nil; Focus later shows no-blocklist state

User story: Finishing drops me into my new home
Expected behavior (from code): cta-finish sets onboardedAt = ClockProvider.now() + save; AppRootView flips to Home with signature fade

User story: minus remembers I onboarded
Expected behavior (from code): Relaunch with onboardedAt set → Home directly; onboarding never reappears

User story: I see a monumental clock
Expected behavior (from code): ClockDisplay 96pt stacked hour/minute (DisplayStack leading 1.0); 24h zero-padded; fixed-width CoreText digit slots — zero horizontal shift on tick

User story: My intention sits under the clock
Expected behavior (from code): UserConfig.intentionText at .body boneWhite max-w 300; omitted entirely when empty

User story: I open an essential app in one tap
Expected behavior (from code): EssentialAppList row → openURL(urlScheme); canOpenURL false → fog 0.4 + "not installed" + inert
Notes: tel: unavailable on sim by design

User story: The launcher feels alive but calm
Expected behavior (from code): Rows stagger in 50ms (once per appear); mnPress 0.97; reduce-motion → crossfade only

User story: An empty launcher points me to settings
Expected behavior (from code): essentials-empty fog line → push .settings

User story: I always see my running session
Expected behavior (from code): focus-state-line "focused · MM:SS left" ticking from ClockProvider; tap → push .focus

User story: I see my next scheduled block
Expected behavior (from code): Idle + enabled schedules → earliest ScheduleMath.nextOccurrence rendered "next · name · day time"

User story: Idle home invites focus quietly
Expected behavior (from code): No session/schedules → fog "begin a focus session" → push .focus

User story: Revoked permission is visible not silent
Expected behavior (from code): authorizationStatus denied + onboarded → banner-permission fog band above nav → push .settings

User story: I reach every area from the nav row
Expected behavior (from code): NavTextRow FOCUS/AWARENESS/SETTINGS push routes; back returns; ≥44pt targets

User story: I pick a duration in one glance
Expected behavior (from code): Presets 15/30/60/120 + custom; custom validates ≥15 (ScheduleMath.minimumWindowMinutes); invalid inert

User story: Starting a session shields instantly
Expected behavior (from code): cta-start → coordinator.start: applyShields + startEndTimer + FocusSession row + snapshot; ActiveSessionView appears

User story: The countdown is sculptural and stable
Expected behavior (from code): ActiveSessionView displaySm/display countdown MM:SS in fixed slots; prism void behind; ticks from ClockProvider

User story: Normal strictness ends in one tap
Expected behavior (from code): strictness normal → END SESSION visible; tap → endEarly: shields cleared + row endedEarly + home idle

User story: Friction strictness makes me hold
Expected behavior (from code): strictness friction → hold-to-end (≈2s linear fill; release snaps back fast); completes → endEarly

User story: Strict mode hides the exit
Expected behavior (from code): strictness strict → no end control rendered during active session

User story: Sessions end themselves on time
Expected behavior (from code): Mock end timer fires → ledger event → reconcile closes row completed → UI returns idle

User story: Shields lift even if I killed the app
Expected behavior (from code): MonitorExtension.intervalDidEnd clears named store + ledger; foreground reconcile marks completed

User story: No blocklist means a gentle setup nudge
Expected behavior (from code): selectionData nil → empty state + CTA to choose apps (re-uses BlockedStep flow)

User story: Denied permission explains itself
Expected behavior (from code): authorizationStatus denied → state copy + settings link; start CTA absent

User story: Focus always shows a running session
Expected behavior (from code): activeSnapshot != nil → ActiveSessionView not presets (also via HO-6 push)

User story: Schedules start empty and honest
Expected behavior (from code): ScheduleListView empty state fog copy + create CTA

User story: I create a weekday schedule safely
Expected behavior (from code): Editor validates ≥15m window / same-day / ≥1 weekday / overlap warning / ~19-activity budget with visible limit state; register writes scheduleRegistry

User story: Toggling a schedule takes effect
Expected behavior (from code): isEnabled toggle → register/unregister expansions; registry reflects

User story: Deleting a schedule cleans up
Expected behavior (from code): Delete confirm → unregister + registry entries removed + row deleted

User story: I see minutes reclaimed today
Expected behavior (from code): StatsService.focusSeconds over FocusSession rows; zero state when none

User story: I see the week and completed count
Expected behavior (from code): weekSeconds + sessionsCompleted tiles derive live

User story: My streak is honest about today
Expected behavior (from code): StreakService.currentStreak (today pending doesn't break)

User story: Real screen time renders on device
Expected behavior (from code): ReportSection embeds DeviceActivityReport(.dailyOverview) with skeleton during async load

User story: The simulator says so instead of lying
Expected behavior (from code): isMock → placeholder tiles labeled simulator data

User story: Denied permission degrades gracefully
Expected behavior (from code): denied → app-owned stats still render; report area explains missing access

User story: I can rewrite my intention
Expected behavior (from code): Edit via FieldShell → UserConfig.intentionText persists → Home reflects

User story: I curate my essentials later
Expected behavior (from code): Editor toggles/reorders EssentialApp rows; Home order follows sortOrder

User story: I can change what gets blocked
Expected behavior (from code): Re-present picker (mock/live per service); selectionData + updatedAt rewritten; summary counts update

User story: Stale tokens offer recovery not crash
Expected behavior (from code): selectionData decode failure → recovery row "re-pick your blocked apps" → picker
Notes: Simulated via corrupt data in sim

User story: Strictness changes apply to running sessions
Expected behavior (from code): Strictness picker writes UserConfig; ActiveSessionView end-early control re-renders per level

User story: Permission state is visible and fixable
Expected behavior (from code): Row shows approved/denied; denied → link opens system Settings app

User story: About tells the truth
Expected behavior (from code): Version from bundle; font/license credits; DEBUG monitor log viewer (SharedState.monitorLog)

User story: Reset gives me a clean slate
Expected behavior (from code): Confirm → resetAll (stores cleared + monitoring stopped) + container wipe + SharedState.reset → onboarding
